> 第21章 梦星的力量（第1页）
赤睛白虎跳上峡谷之后，如同灯笼般大小的眼睛露出凶光，朝着苏辰快速追赶而去。
虽然刚才的战斗之中，这赤睛白虎已然受伤不轻，可速度依旧快如疾风，不断的拉近跟苏辰的距离。
而且，他们一追一逃，动静太大，很可能引来越来越多的妖兽，甚至引发兽潮！
果然，苏辰逃窜了没多久，一声声兽吼便是朝着他逼近。
此时，他也只有梦星这一根救命稻草。
脑海之中，梦星的声音缓缓传出：“现在这种情况，我只能告诉你三个字。”
苏辰在脑海之中呼喊了几声，而此时，梦星已然没有了任何回应，让苏辰的心彻底沉入了谷底。
“妈的，不管了，我直接往妖兽山脉内围冲，我不信这头畜生敢跟着我进去！”
苏辰朝着十万大山内部冲去，而周围一头头妖兽被赤睛白虎的声音吸引，也是朝着苏辰冲了过来。
苏辰怒吼一声，一掌击杀了身前一头一阶妖兽，但霎那之间，又有数头妖兽朝他冲来，苏辰只能拼命躲闪。
苏辰一个不慎，便是被一头妖兽抓中了后背，顿时出现了三道狰狞的抓痕，鲜血飞溅！
苏辰只感觉后背火辣辣的疼痛，但也只有咬咬牙，继续往前冲。
他现在是看出来了，梦星根本就没有救自己的意思。
对于梦星是否会出手保自己的性命，苏辰没有一点底，毕竟直至现在，苏辰也不确定梦星到底为什么帮助自己！
幸好他的身体远远强于普通武者，否则在这许多妖兽的攻击之下恐怕早已经丧命。
苏辰一路狂奔，不知道冲出了多远，只感觉自己头晕眼花，体内的元力也渐渐枯竭。
在一众妖兽的摧残之下，他身上已经布满了伤痕，就连一身黑色的衣袍，此时都被撕成一条一条。
迷迷糊糊之间，苏辰只感觉自己身后的妖兽越来越少，而周围的环境也越来越静谧。

不知跑出多远之后，苏辰终于耗尽了全部的力气，一下子摔倒在地上，昏迷过去。
正在这时，苏辰胸口上的天机宝玉散发出一道光芒。
梦星那如梦似幻般的身影，浮现在苏辰身边。
黑夜之中，梦星浑身一尘不染，身上散发着柔和的光芒，宛如仙女一般。
梦星只一招手，苏辰的身体便是凭空漂浮起来，跟她一同向前走去。
一头四阶狮类妖兽发现了梦星的身影，警惕的爬起身来，怒吼一声。
但还不等它对梦星发起攻击，一股莫名其妙的力量便是向着这头妖兽笼罩住。
一刹那间，那头实力相当于人类大武师的四阶妖兽便直接炸成了一团血雾！
而自始至终，梦星除了带了苏辰往前走之外，没有任何动作，甚至连一个眼神都没有。
飞溅的鲜血，在逼近梦星周身一丈范围之时便被一股神秘的力量生生阻隔住。
梦星将苏辰带到了一个宽阔的山洞中。
手指一点，一股淡蓝色的光芒从她指尖涌出，缓缓的流入到苏辰的身体之中。
随着那光芒流入，苏辰身上那狰狞的伤痕竟然开始缓缓愈合。
鲜血停止流淌，破损的皮肉不断的蠕动，自行生长。
三息时间过后，那一道道伤口便是化为了浅浅的白色痕迹。
这般手段，即使是有武王在场，也定要惊得目瞪口呆！
因为这根本不是人类武者能够拥有的力量！
做完这一切，梦星的身影才是缓缓消散。

> Chapter 21 The Power of Dream Star (Page 1)
After the red-eyed white tiger jumped up into the canyon, its eyes as big as lanterns revealed a fierce light, and it quickly chased after Su Chen.
Although the red-eyed white tiger was seriously injured in the battle just now, it was still as fast as the wind, constantly closing the distance with Su Chen.
Moreover, as they chased and escaped, they made too much noise, which might attract more and more monsters, or even trigger a tide of monsters!
Sure enough, not long after Su Chen fled, beast roars approached him.
At this time, he only had Mengxing as a life-saving straw.
In my mind, Mengxing's voice slowly came out: "In this situation, I can only tell you three words."
Su Chen shouted several times in his mind, but at this time, Mengxing had no response, making Su Chen's heart completely sink to the bottom.
"Damn it, no matter what, I will rush directly into the Monster Mountain Range. I don't believe this beast dares to follow me in!"
Su Chen rushed towards the inside of Shiwan Mountain, and the monster beasts around him were attracted by the sound of the red-eyed white tiger, and also rushed towards Su Chen.
Su Chen roared angrily and killed a first-level monster in front of him with one palm, but in an instant, several more monsters rushed towards him, and Su Chen could only dodge desperately.
Su Chen accidentally got scratched on the back by a monster. Three hideous scratches appeared immediately, and blood splattered!
Su Chen only felt the burning pain in his back, but he could only grit his teeth and continue to rush forward.
He could see now that Mengxing had no intention of saving him.
Su Chen had no idea whether Mengxing would take action to save his life. After all, until now, Su Chen was not sure why Mengxing helped him!
Fortunately, his body was much stronger than that of ordinary warriors, otherwise he would have been killed by the attacks of so many monsters.
Su Chen ran all the way, not knowing how far he had rushed. He only felt dizzy and the energy in his body was gradually drying up.
Under the ravages of the monster beasts, his body was covered with scars, and even his black robe was torn into pieces.
In a daze, Su Chen felt that there were fewer and fewer monsters behind him, and the surrounding environment was getting quieter and quieter.
After running no matter how far away, Su Chen finally exhausted all his strength, fell to the ground and passed out.
At this moment, the Tianji Baoyu on Su Chen's chest emitted a ray of light.
Mengxing's dreamlike figure appeared next to Su Chen.
In the dark night, Mengxing's body was spotless, and her body exuded a soft light, like a fairy.
Mengxing waved her hand, and Su Chen's body floated out of thin air and walked forward with her.
A fourth-level lion monster discovered Mengxing's figure, got up vigilantly, and roared angrily.
But before it could launch an attack on Mengxing, an inexplicable force enveloped the monster.
In an instant, the fourth-level monster, whose strength was equivalent to that of a great human martial artist, exploded into a ball of blood mist!
From the beginning to the end, Mengxing made no movement or even a look except leading Su Chen forward.
The splashing blood was blocked by a mysterious force as it approached within ten feet of Mengxing's body.
Mengxing brought Su Chen to a wide cave.
With a click of her finger, a light blue light emerged from her fingertips and slowly flowed into Su Chen's body.
As the light flowed in, the hideous scars on Su Chen's body began to heal slowly.
The blood stopped flowing, and the damaged flesh continued to squirm and grow on its own.
After three breaths, the wounds turned into shallow white marks.
With such a method, even if King Wu is present, he will definitely be shocked.Got to be stunned!
Because this is simply not a power that human warriors can possess!
After doing all this, Mengxing's figure slowly disappeared.
